rulesTestNames: lets active managers get their setup defaults view and nothing else
owner: Host event setup defaults evaluator: hostReadModels event setup default view triggers
read: current managers of an active organizer get their organizer's document; a view not written yet reads as missing; nobody lists the collection
write: server only; written by every evaluation that changes it and deleted with the organizer
migrationNotes: The view carries the basics, preferences and reviewed-defaults hashes the defaults update command and the first-save basics are fenced by; the client never recomputes them.
